answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks with synchronous Equihash audits. Each epoch, a beacon emits a seed signal that every node mixes with its public key to solve a memory-hard Equihash puzzle before a tight cutoff, while verifiers check proofs cheaply. Because short windows prevent time-sharing RAM across accounts, attackers need dedicated DRAM per fake identity. Yet honest nodes behind a congested wireless bridge on an island often miss cutoffs and get evicted.
